title: ResSAGELink: Residual GraphSAGE with Layer-wise Jumping Knowledge for Robust Drug Repurposing.
snippet: Drug repositioning offers a cost-effective alternative to traditional drug discovery. However, computational methods often struggle to capture multi-scale structural patterns and frequently suffer from information loss in deep architectures.
